stories.title: Texas Hosts Texas State Tomorrow — First Fall Home Showdown
stories.angle: Texas hosts Texas State Monday Oct 13 at 6 PM CT at McCombs Field (free admission). The Longhorns opened fall with a 28-1 win over Murray State. A strong showing tomorrow sets the stage for the marquee Nov 6 matchup at Texas A&M.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Texas softball hosts Texas State TOMORROW — McCombs Field, 6 PM CT, free.

After a 28-1 fall opener, this is the first real test for Torres and Kavan together. Nov. 6 at A&M is the real prize. #HookEm #Softball

facebook.long_form:
The Texas Longhorns are hosting Texas State TOMORROW — Monday, October 13 — at McCombs Field in Austin, and it's completely free to attend.

Kickoff is at 6 PM CT, and this is just the second fall game for the back-to-back national champions. Texas opened their fall schedule with a dominant 28-1 win over Murray State on September 29, but Texas State will provide a much sterner test.

This is more than just a fall game. It's the first public look at how Isa Torres and Taryn Kavan mesh together in actual competition. Torres (the 2026 D1Softball Player of the Year — .530 BA, 16 HR, 56 RBI at FSU) and Kavan (two-time WCWS Most Outstanding Player) haven't played a competitive game together yet.

After tomorrow, the Longhorns have four more fall dates before the big one: a road trip to Texas A&M on November 6 at 7 PM CT. The rivalry game will be must-watch college softball.

If you're anywhere near Austin tomorrow evening, free admission and two of the best players in the country in the same dugout. Don't miss it.
facebook.image_caption: Texas softball at McCombs Field tomorrow — Oct. 13, 6 PM CT, FREE. Back-to-back champs, Torres + Kavan together. 🤘 #HookEm

stories.title: LSU Softball Opens Fall Tuesday, Then Heads to Orange Beach vs. Florida State
stories.angle: LSU opens fall on Oct 15 vs Northwestern State at Tiger Park (free). The Tigers then travel to the Orange Beach Sportsplex (Oct 24-25) for back-to-back games against Florida State — the most high-profile early fall inter-program matchup on the calendar. Home fall schedule continues through the Purple/Gold World Series Nov 17-19.

x_posts.text:
LSU opens fall ball WEDNESDAY (Oct. 15) vs. Northwestern State — Tiger Park, free.

Then LSU vs. Florida State at Orange Beach Oct. 24-25.

SEC vs. ACC. Fall ball just got a marquee matchup. #GeauxTigers #Softball

facebook.long_form:
Mark your calendars, college softball fans: LSU opens fall ball this Wednesday, October 15, hosting Northwestern State at Tiger Park in Baton Rouge. Admission is free.

The highlight comes a week and a half later — October 24-25 — when the Tigers travel to the Orange Beach Sportsplex in Orange Beach, Alabama, for back-to-back games against Florida State.

LSU vs. Florida State. SEC vs. ACC. Two programs that have combined for multiple national championships and WCWS appearances. This is exactly the kind of fall ball matchup that gets the college softball world talking.

LSU's full fall schedule runs through the Purple/Gold World Series on November 17-19 at Tiger Park. Florida State closes out fall November 13 at Florida, setting up an SEC-ACC weekend to cap the preseason.

Orange Beach is becoming the fall ball destination of choice. This one could be a preview of the postseason.

facebook.long_form:
Oklahoma softball's Battle Series returns in two days, and Tuesday's Game 3 at Love's Field is shaping up to be the biggest one yet.

Details: Tuesday, October 14, 6:30 PM CT at Love's Field in Norman. General admission tickets are $10.88. The game will also be streamed live on 1Oklahoma.com.

The series opened September 30 with a walk-off — a two-RBI double by Ailana Agbayani that turned Love's Field into a celebration. Since then, Sooner fans have been counting down to Game 3.

Tuesday is a chance to see Kendall Wells (39 HR last season — the NCAA Division I freshman record, and 2026 NFCA Freshman of the Year), Jayda Kavan (two-time WCWS Most Outstanding Player), Jaylen Cruz, Natalie Ludlow, and the rest of a team with championship expectations heading into 2027.

Game 4 is October 21. Oklahoma missed the WCWS in 2026, and they are hungry to get back. Tuesday is your chance to watch that hunger in person for $10.88.

stories.title: Class of 2028 Recruiting — Grace Tonga to Oklahoma, Brooklyn Evans to Florida
stories.angle: Oklahoma added their 5th 2028 commit on Sept 22: Grace Tonga (outfielder). Florida landed catcher Brooklyn Evans. The Oct 17-18 contact period opens next week — expect a burst of commitments across top programs. OU has now locked down half a projected 2028 recruiting class already.

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
Oklahoma already has FIVE 2028 commitments — including OF Grace Tonga (Sept. 22).

The NCAA fall contact period opens Oct. 17-18. A wave of commits is coming. #Softball #Recruiting

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
Florida adds top catcher Brooklyn Evans to the 2028 class.

No. 2 overall Kylie Holden is already a Gator, too.

Tim Walton is quietly building one of the best 2028 classes anywhere. #Gators #Softball

facebook.long_form:
We are still two full years away from the 2028 season — but the top programs in college softball are already building rosters, and the class is taking shape fast.

Oklahoma secured their fifth 2028 commitment on September 22, when outfielder Grace Tonga pledged to the Sooners. Patty Gasso's staff now has five commits locked in — an unusually deep early list for a class this far out.

Florida is stacking up talent as well. The Gators landed catcher Brooklyn Evans as their latest commitment. And don't forget: Florida also secured Kylie Holden — the No. 2 overall recruit in the 2028 class — just two weeks ago. With Holden and Evans both committed, Florida is locking down the top of its 2028 pipeline early.

The timing matters: the NCAA fall contact period for 2028 prospects opens this weekend — October 17-18. Expect a flurry of new commitments in the next few days.

South Carolina (Aspen Boulware, No. 1 overall), Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Arizona have all been active. Who lands the top 2028 class? Let us know below! ⬇️
facebook.image_caption: Oklahoma's Class of 2028 is already 5 commits deep — and the contact period opens Oct. 17. Patty Gasso building early. 🏆 #Sooners #Softball

The quiet 2027 title contender. #Gators #Softball

facebook.long_form:
Florida softball opens fall ball this Thursday, October 16, hosting Santa Fe College at Katie Seashole Pressly Stadium in Gainesville. Admission is free.

And when fans walk through those gates Thursday, they'll be watching what might be the most loaded Florida roster in years.

The Gators return six of their nine everyday starters from 2026, plus their entire pitching staff. That's rare. In the modern transfer portal era, most programs lose key arms between seasons. Florida held theirs. Add two new transfers and a top-recruiting class, and head coach Tim Walton has assembled something very real.

When the 2027 national title conversation happens, it centers on Texas (defending back-to-back), Oklahoma (hungry to return), Tennessee (WCWS finalist). Florida doesn't always get the same attention — but the numbers say they should.

Six returning starters. Full pitching staff. Two transfers. A top class coming in. Fall ball starts Thursday. Get acquainted with the 2027 Gators now — before everyone else does.
